t: The Time Cat 5e Grey 4-Pair 8-Core Ethernet Cable is a dependable solution for indoor data and networking installations. With four pairs of colour-coded solid copper conductors, it provides stable and efficient signal transmission for LAN, broadband, and communication systems. The unshielded design with a durable grey PVC sheath allows for easy handling and installation while maintaining reliable performance. Supplied on a 100m drum, it’s ideal for professional and commercial network set-ups.
